selection_rule: Minimize false proceed on unrelated plus insufficient_evidence; then maximize retained context-sufficient positives; then minimize enabled conditions; then policy_id. All-abstain candidates cannot be selected.
threshold_construction: No labels: cosine thresholds disabled plus empirical Q25/Q50/Q75 of returned top cosine; coverage zero or empirical median; source-reference hit minimum zero or one. At most 20 unique combinations, plus an all-abstain negative control.

disabled_condition_rationales.other_topical_counts: Counts largely saturate under fixed top5; no justified extra search dimension.
disabled_condition_rationales.rrf_bm25_thresholds: RRF is rank fusion and BM25 language dependent; no additional scale tuning on 32 exposed cases.
disabled_condition_rationales.other_evidence_and_traversal_minima: Graph density/counts do not prove query-specific evidence sufficiency.
disabled_condition_rationales.max_traversed_limitation_node_count: Limitations are necessary context; their presence must not be penalized.

qualification_blockers.effect: Process creation establishes launch command, not successful cmdlet completion; this consumer cannot support a policy-qualified result.
